{{Top|notoc=1}}
A '''recharge coupling''' was a circular [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component that allowed the unit to take on power. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] such as models like the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO]], [[M-3PO military protocol droid|M-3PO]], and [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series]] had their recharge coupling located in the middle of their torsos, while [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] had their situated at the bottom of their [[Armor/Legends|armored]] housing.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
